dogecoin.text:
Episode: 9.5

I don’t know what was more fun (or sad): SNL or $DOGE price (when will I get good at selling?). I wanna see if this beat Chapelle for #1 on the season. This one got the green light on expenses; besides the first song, were there any weak spots?  

#SNL #ElonMusk

Western sketch: 9/10

Elon would've got beaten up a lot in the Old West and, in '80s, $DOGE laughed out of the saloon. 

#SNL #ElonMusk

Update: 10/10

Lol, $DOGE, but my RH doesn't work.

"Why are all these rich white people trying to go to space?"

"I could be pretty, too, but I sleep on my feet like a horse."

Can't waste that Baby Yoda costume (or Kyle being it). 

#SNL #ElonMusk

Iceland sketch: 9/10

A throwback to the Fred Armisen days? A good foreign caricature (dating must be hard in Iceland) and McDormand and Björk (was the sketch just for Melissa?). $DOGE is freezing on RH, I think.

#SNL #ElonMusk

Post-pandemic sketch: 8/10

"Ups and downs? You stabbed your husband with a screwdriver."

Elon needs to drop some more $DOGE. 

#SNL #ElonMusk

Monologue: 9/10

The Doge Master is trying, and the writers did him good, and $DOGE is going wild. 

"Did you think I was going to be a chill and normal dude? This is my son's name. It's pronounced Cat-Running-Across-the-Keyboard." 

#SNL #ElonMusk
